annotations.title: What 2026 conduit loans were underwritten to

description: Debt service coverage (DSCR), loan-to-value, debt yield and coupon percentiles (10th to 90th) plus the share of full-term interest-only loans for CMBS conduit loans originated in the last 12 months, read from the trusts' own SEC ABS-EE filings. Cut by property type or by loan term (5 or 10 years); with neither, the whole market plus a median line for every property type and term.

include_trusts.description: Also list the CMBS trusts in this cut with a link to each one's SEC filing.

property_type.description: Property type: multifamily, retail, self-storage, lodging, office, mixed-use, manufactured-housing, industrial, other ("lodging" is hotel). Omit for all types.

term.description: Loan term in years, 5 or 10. Omit for all terms. Cannot be combined with property_type.
